title: DOCI Document
description: A row in the `documents` table plus its on-disk markdown body. The same shape is used by GET /api/documents.php?content=1 (full read) and as the response body of POST/PUT /api/documents.php (without `content` unless requested).

guid.description: Stable identifier. Survives path renames; the entire reason GUIDs exist.

path.description: Filesystem path relative to `files/`. Always ends in .md; auto-appended on create if missing. Only alphanumerics, `_`, `-`, `.`, `/` (see lib/validation.php sanitize_path).

parent_guid.description: For doc_type='thread': the document the thread is attached to. Null for plain documents.

original_guid.description: For doc_type='version': the live document this is a snapshot of.

summary.description: Optional one-line description used in folder cards and search results.

quote.description: Threads only: the selected passage on the parent document that this thread anchors to.

content.description: The raw markdown body. Present only when ?content=1 is passed to GET.

created_by.description: Identity string from the proxy's Remote-User header at create time.

access.description: Reserved for per-document ACL. Not wired in v0.1.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete tombstone. Soft-deleted rows are excluded from default reads.

url.description: Convenience absolute URL returned by mutations: `${APP_URL}/${guid}`.
